comment: Single source of truth for the Cost Cockpit data model. Used by scripts/provision_dataverse.py, the browser-console script and the data dictionary.

tables.description: Product or plant configuration whose cost is monitored.

columns.description: Short unique code, e.g. DEMO. Used as key for imports.
Project size the cost baseline refers to.
Size of one product module; used by the per-module scaling rule.

tables.description: Node of the cost breakdown structure. Carries scope, TIC category and the scaling rule.

columns.description: Unique code incl. product prefix, e.g. DEMO-2.1. No / : ? & characters.
1 = top level.
NCA scope, EPC scope or owner. Set on leaf elements.
Category for total-installed-cost reporting.
How the cost of this element changes with project size.
Exponent n of the power law; only used with scaling method 'Power law'.
Cost items may only be booked on leaf elements.
Name of the person responsible for this cost element.

tables.description: Supplier master, fed from Teamcenter.

columns.description: Vendor ID in Teamcenter.

tables.description: Exchange rate to EUR per currency; copied onto cost items at import.

columns.description: 1 unit of the currency = x EUR.

tables.description: Version of the cost baseline of a product. Draft versions are edited, released versions are frozen.

columns.description: Unique code, e.g. DEMO-V001.
Marks the version that targets and measures refer to.
Set to Yes to start the release flow.

tables.description: Lowest cost level: one priced item, hour block or lump sum within a cost version.

columns.description: Unique key: version code + '~' + CBS code + '~' + item id. Used for upsert.
Pieces, hours, lots ...
In the currency given by currency code.
ISO code, e.g. EUR.
Copied from the FX rate table at import. Blank is treated as 1.
Quantity x unit price x FX rate. Written by import and by the flow 'Cost item - set amount'.

tables.description: Product feature or design option whose cost effect is tracked.

columns.description: Standard features are part of the baseline.

tables.description: Effect of a feature on one CBS element: the feature-to-TIC dependency.

columns.description: EUR, EUR per MW or percent, depending on impact type. Negative values are savings.
Cost type of the effect; decides which regional factor applies.

tables.description: Project location for regional cost factors.
Cost factor of a region for one cost type, relative to the base region (1.0).

columns.description: Region code + '~' + cost type number.
1.000 = same cost as base region.

tables.description: What-if case: a cost version calculated for a project size, a region and a set of features.

columns.description: Copied from the product by the calculation flow.
Copied from the product by the calculation flow.
Price-year adjustment; blank is treated as 1.
Set to Yes to start the calculation flow.
Set to Yes to publish the CAPEX dataset for the LCOH Suite.
Written by the calculation flow.
Written by the calculation flow.

formulas.description: Project size divided by reference size.

formulas.formula: If('Module size (MW)' > 0 && 'Reference size (MW)' > 0, RoundUp('Project size (MW)' / 'Module size (MW)', 0) / RoundUp('Reference size (MW)' / 'Module size (MW)', 0), 0)
formulas.description: Number of modules at project size divided by number of modules at reference size.

tables.description: Feature selected in a scenario.

columns.description: Scenario code + '~' + feature code.

tables.description: Result line of a scenario per CBS element and cost type. Inputs are written by the flow, results are formula columns.

columns.description: Cost at reference size in the base region.
1 = per module, 2 = power law, 3 = fixed.

formulas.formula: If('Scaling code' = 1, Float('Module ratio'), If('Scaling code' = 2, Power(Float('Size ratio'), Float('Scaling exponent')), Float(1)))
formulas.description: Scaling rule applied to the base amount.

formulas.formula: Float('Base amount (EUR)') * 'Scale factor' * Float('Regional factor') * Float('Escalation factor')
formulas.description: Base amount x scale factor x regional factor x escalation factor.
Final cost divided by project size in kW.

tables.description: Published scenario result per scope and TIC category. This is the interface table the LCOH Suite reads.

columns.description: Scenario code + '~' + scope number + '~' + TIC category number.

tables.description: Cost data point of an own product, a competitor or a public study.

columns.description: Product, competitor or study the value belongs to.
Scope the value covers, if known.
Leave blank for a total-plant value.
State what is included and excluded.

tables.description: Target value per CBS element.

columns.description: Target at reference size.

tables.description: Cost-down idea submitted by a colleague.

columns.description: Per plant at reference size.

tables.description: Cost-down measure with owner, saving, effort and degree of implementation.

columns.description: Per plant at reference size.
Cost per person-day used for the score; blank is treated as 800.

formulas.formula: If(('One-off cost (EUR)' + 'Effort (person-days)' * If(IsBlank('Day rate (EUR)'), 800, 'Day rate (EUR)')) > 0, 'Saving (EUR)' * 'Probability (%)' / 100 / ('One-off cost (EUR)' + 'Effort (person-days)' * If(IsBlank('Day rate (EUR)'), 800, 'Day rate (EUR)')), 0)
formulas.description: Weighted saving per EUR of implementation cost.

tables.description: Remembers which CBS element and cost type a Teamcenter item belongs to, so that re-imports are mapped automatically.
Staging table for rows exported from Teamcenter before they become cost items.

columns.description: Identifier of the import, e.g. 2026-11-16 or the export file name.
Filled from the mapping table or by hand.
